'''Fallen Revan's Lightsaber''' was the [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] wielded by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]-turned-[[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]]. He wielded it before and during his reign as the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]].<ref name="T8">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 8: The Jedi Civil War|int=Timeline 8: The Jedi Civil War}}</ref>

[[File:Revanconfronted.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Darth Revan wielded his Sith lightsaber during [[Bastila Shan]]'s attempt to capture him.]]
Revan wielded this [[Lightsaber/Legends|weapon]] during the later years of the [[Mandalorian Wars]] and wielded it [[Battle of Malachor V|against]] [[Mandalore the Ultimate]].<ref name="T9" /> After being [[Mission to Dromund Kaas|turned]] to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] by the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]], Revan kept the saber as his weapon; however, he replaced the original [[Color/Legends|blue]] [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|crystal]] with a [[Synthetic lightsaber crystal/Legends|synthetic crimson one]].<ref name="T8" />

During the [[Jedi Civil War]], Revan wielded this weapon against the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], including when [[Bastila Shan]] [[Capture of Darth Revan|led]] a [[Jedi strike team (Capture of Darth Revan)|strike team]] to capture the Dark Lord aboard his cruiser.<ref name="KotOR game" />

{{Weapon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Jedi_Knight_Revan-SWGoH.jpg|thumb|left|300px|The lightsaber of "Jedi Knight Revan" in ''Galaxy of Heroes'' is in fact his Sith lightsaber.]]
The hilt for this saber first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] developed by [[BioWare]] and released in [[2003]],<ref name="KotOR Release">{{SW|url=news/kotor-galaxy-of-heroes|text=BioWare and Capital Games on Bringing ''KotOR'' Fan Favorites into ''Galaxy of Heroes''|nolive=1}}</ref> as the standard hilt of all one-handed lightsabers in the game.<ref name="KotOR game" /> In [[2008]],<ref name="CSWE Release">{{PenguinRandomHouse|url=books/160596/the-complete-star-wars-encyclopedia-by-stephen-j-sansweet-pablo-hidalgo-bob-vitas-daniel-wallace/9780345477637|text=The Complete Star Wars® Encyclopedia}}</ref> it was identified as Darth Revan's lightsaber and depicted in the ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|255|Notable Lightsabers}}</ref> In [[2020]], the lightsaber was released on ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' [[Cartel Market]], under the name "Fallen Revan's Lightsaber".<ref name="SWTOR">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20201209-0|text=Cartel Market Additions: Game Update 6.2}}</ref>

In [[2018]],<ref name="SWGOH Date 1">{{EASWYouTube|KMi8RBCQv9E|Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes - Legend of the Old Republic}}</ref> the lightsaber was added to the video game ''[[Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes]]'' as the weapon wielded by character "Jedi Knight Revan",<ref name="SWGOH">''[[Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes]]''</ref> while character "Darth Revan", added in [[2019]],<ref name="SWGOH Date 2">{{EASWYouTube|VSdNf177m0o|Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes — The Scourge of the Old Republic}}</ref> would wield another [[Redeemed Revan's Lightsaber|lightsaber]],<ref name="SWGOH" /> the weapon usually associated with post-Sith Revan.<ref name="SWTOR" />
